gta.deck: After 13 years, Rockstar's return to Vice City unlocks at midnight local time on PS5 and Xbox — about 16m copies pre-sold for $1.5bn; a 212GB download.
gta.headline: GTA VI launches at midnight

gulf.deck: Houthi cruise missiles aimed at Riyadh were shot down. Reuters, Thu 19 Nov: the escalation goes on as diplomacy to end the war stays deadlocked.
gulf.headline: Houthis fire on Riyadh; Saudi says danger passed

jeffries.deck: House Democrats chose Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker in a closed-door vote on Wednesday; if the full House elects him on 3 Jan, he is the first Black Speaker.
jeffries.headline: Jeffries nominated, 251–11

kerch.deck: Traffic was suspended after a new attack, Crimea's Russian-installed governor said on Telegram on Thursday; the road span fell into the sea earlier in the week.
kerch.diagram_caption: THE KERCH BRIDGE — THE ROAD SPAN IS DOWN
kerch.headline: Bridge hit a third time

lead.deck: Xi hugged Trump on the tarmac as he arrived for the APEC summit; the three hold a trilateral with Putin on Thursday — as Kerch is hit a third time.
lead.headline: THREE LEADERS, ONE TABLE
lead.visual_caption: THE THREE FLAGS OVER SHENZHEN — THE U.S., CHINA AND RUSSIA MEET AT THE APEC SUMMIT
